title: sdd MCP server tools (C002-IF-002)
description: Input and output schemas of the sdd MCP server tools. tools/list returns $defs/<tool>Input as inputSchema and $defs/<tool>Output as outputSchema. The document itself validates the structuredContent of any tools/call result: a success output of one tool, or an error result (isError: true). Process and protocol: sdd-mcp-server.md.

path.description: Target file: absolute, or relative to the server's repository root (sdd-mcp-server.md §3). The path guard core decides it (C002-REQ-401).

writeFileInput.title: write_file input
writeFileInput.description: Creates or replaces a whole file under .sdd/ (C002-REQ-403). Missing parent folders inside .sdd/ are created.

content.description: Complete new file content, written as UTF-8 without BOM, line endings unchanged.

replaceTextInput.title: replace_text input
replaceTextInput.description: Replaces one exact text span in an existing file under .sdd/ (C002-REQ-403); the span must occur exactly once (C002-REQ-404).

runCommandInput.title: run_command input
runCommandInput.description: Runs one command allowed by the bash guard core (C002-REQ-405), without a shell (C002-CON-07).

dialect.description: Shell syntax the bash guard core applies to the command (sdd-mcp-server.md §5.2); the command runs without a shell in either case.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock limit; the process is killed when it is reached.

findings.description: Quick-lint findings of the written file in the post-write feedback format of C001-IF-07 §4 (C002-REQ-408).

lines.description: At most 15 findings, errors before warnings before info, each in the CLI human format of C001-IF-01; when total > 15 a last line '… <n> more: run sdd lint --quick --file <path>'.

findingsUnavailable.description: Present instead of findings when the quick-lint check could not run (C002-REQ-409).

runCommandOutput.title: run_command output
runCommandOutput.description: Result of an allowed command (C002-REQ-406). A non-zero exit code is a normal result, not an error result (C002-TS-408).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the command's first segment; pipe-only filters never fail. null when the process was killed at the timeout.

stdout.description: Standard output after the pipe-only filters, UTF-8, at most 1,048,576 characters.

stderr.description: Standard error of the first segment, UTF-8, at most 1,048,576 characters.

errorResult.title: error result
errorResult.description: structuredContent of a result with isError: true. refused: the boundary or a tool rule said no; failed: a fault, and nothing was changed (C002-REQ-402, C002-CON-08).

message.description: For GUARD-* codes the guard core's deny message (C001-IF-07 §4); otherwise the catalogue message of errors.md.
